content.hook_text: A request creates a favour. A schedule creates a default. The night does not need more goodwill. It needs an owner and a roster.
content.problem_text: Every uninterrupted hour he gets feels like proof her exhaustion is invisible, and naming it makes her the difficult one.
content.bold_line: A written roster replaces silent bookkeeping with an observable system. The sleep banker makes exhaustion visible and tradeable — credits and paybacks turn private resentment into a ledger both adults can see.
